```{r}
#| label: inv-config

weighting    <- "inv"
weight_label <- "inverse-distance"

k_values <- c(5, 15, 25, 31, 51, 71, 101)
```

### Inverse-Distance Weighted KNN with Tuned Neighborhood Size

To evaluate how neighborhood size affects distance-weighted classification, we specify a KNN classifier using the `kknn` engine with `weight_func = "inv"`, which weights each neighbor's vote inversely by its Euclidean distance from the query song ($w_i \propto 1 / d_i$). We pair this specification with `knn_rec` inside a `tidymodels` workflow and tune $k \in \{5, 15, 25, 31, 51, 71, 101\}$ across our 5 stratified cross-validation folds on the training set using classification accuracy and multi-class ROC-AUC.

```{r}
#| label: inv-tune

inv_spec <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors = tune(), weight_func = weighting) |>
  set_engine("kknn") |>
  set_mode("classification")

inv_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(knn_rec) |>
  add_model(inv_spec)

inv_grid <- tibble(neighbors = k_values)

set.seed(169)
inv_tuned <- tune_grid(
  inv_wf,
  resamples = spotify_folds,
  grid = inv_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: inv-table

inv_results <- collect_metrics(inv_tuned) |>
  select(neighbors, .metric, mean, std_err) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = c(mean, std_err)) |>
  arrange(neighbors) |>
  select(
    k = neighbors,
    mean_accuracy = mean_accuracy,
    se_accuracy = std_err_accuracy,
    mean_roc_auc = mean_roc_auc,
    se_roc_auc = std_err_roc_auc
  )

inv_results |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 4,
    caption = paste0("5-fold CV performance for ", weight_label, " KNN by k")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: inv-plot
#| fig-cap: !expr paste0("Cross-validated accuracy and ROC-AUC across values of k (", weight_label, " weighting)")

collect_metrics(inv_tuned) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbors, y = mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - std_err, ymax = mean + std_err), width = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ .metric, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_values) +
  labs(x = "Number of neighbors (k)", y = "Mean 5-fold CV estimate") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: inv-select

best_inv_k <- select_best(inv_tuned, metric = "roc_auc")
best_inv_row <- inv_results |> filter(k == best_inv_k$neighbors)
```

Using mean ROC-AUC as the selection criterion, cross-validation favors $k = `r best_inv_k$neighbors`$ for the inverse-distance model, achieving a mean ROC-AUC of `r round(best_inv_row$mean_roc_auc, 4)` (SE = `r round(best_inv_row$se_roc_auc, 4)`) and a mean accuracy of `r round(best_inv_row$mean_accuracy, 4)` (SE = `r round(best_inv_row$se_accuracy, 4)`). In overlapping regions of the audio feature space, expanding the neighborhood size stabilizes predictions against isolated outlier songs, while inverse-distance weighting ensures that the closest neighbors still carry the greatest voting influence rather than being outvoted by points near the outer edge of the neighborhood.

### Final Model Evaluation on the Test Set

We finalize the workflow with the selected $k$, refit it on the full training set, and evaluate it once on the test set to obtain an unbiased estimate of performance.

```{r}
#| label: inv-final

final_inv_wf <- finalize_workflow(inv_wf, best_inv_k)

final_inv_fit <- last_fit(
  final_inv_wf,
  spotify_split,
  metrics = metric_set(accuracy, roc_auc)
)

collect_metrics(final_inv_fit) |>
  select(.metric, .estimate) |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 4,
    caption = paste0("Test-set performance for ", weight_label, " KNN (k = ", best_inv_k$neighbors, ")")
  )
```
Evaluated on the held-out test set, the finalized inverse-distance KNN model ($k = 51$) achieves a multi-class ROC-AUC of 0.7831 and a classification accuracy of 0.4481, confirming that cross-validation performance generalizes well to unseen songs.
